items.title: Iran says Strait of Hormuz to remain closed until US fulfills commitments
items.title_zh: 伊朗称霍尔木兹保持关闭直至美方履行承诺：指向六月协议
items.summary_zh: 阿纳多卢社9月20日：加利巴夫在议会称，霍尔木兹将保持关闭，直至美方履行六月协议承诺并满足伊方经中介转达的条件；“欺骗与单方面强加之路已经关闭”。六月停火/通航谅解随后因航行与安保安排分歧崩解，美军封锁伊朗南部港口与伊方控峡叙事持续对撞。

quotes.author: Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf / Anadolu Agency
quotes.en: Until these conditions are met, the legitimate rights of the Iranian nation are recognised, and American commitments are fulfilled, there will be no opening for a return to the previous state of negotiations or for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
quotes.zh: 在这些条件得到满足、伊朗民族合法权利得到承认、美方承诺得到履行之前，不会出现回到先前谈判状态或重开霍尔木兹的开口。

items.title: Show HN: Sigabrt.dev – cronjob monitor with an SSH TUI
items.title_zh: Show HN：Sigabrt.dev——带 SSH TUI 的 cron 监控
items.summary_zh: 作者展示用 SSH 终端 UI 做 cron/任务心跳监控的小工具；评论立刻甩出 healthchecks.io 与自制 macOS 监控 App 作为对照。

quotes.author: p2004a
quotes.en: I'm myself very happy with https://healthchecks.io/ for this purpose.
quotes.zh: 我自己很满意用 healthchecks.io 做这个用途。

quotes.author: mosselman
quotes.en: Shameless plug for a server monitoring macOS app I built. I built that too for the servers I managed myself. Instead of working through a service or a self-hosted monitoring tool that I then over to monitor itself again, I thought running it on my laptop was pretty nice too. One of the next features I've been wanting to build is uptime monitoring. https://kitaso.app/ Sure there is the downside of having to be at your laptop or having it on, but the upside is that it has very few moving parts and is very simple and it just has one set price.
quotes.zh: 无耻推销一下我做的 macOS 服务器监控 App——当初也是为了自己管的机器。

items.title: Pakistan Iran talks: Mohsin Naqvi visits Tehran amid US-Iran tensions, Red Sea shipping fears
items.title_zh: 巴基斯坦内政部长纳奎访德黑兰：伊方称纯属双边，调停叙事并行

quotes.zh: 巴基斯坦内政部长此访完全在双边讨论的框架之内。

quotes.author: ascots
quotes.en: looks like we both created educational materials about the same topics - except yours clearly is higher effort in terms of prose and human effort. https://learn.mimmsy.com/ Was toying with the idea that with everyone vibe coding niche educational sites (this is a claim about myself, not this site) it would be nice if that effort could go into building an auditable library of widgets/ educational resources users could trust. items.title: A war and several high-level meetings
items.title_zh: 一场战争与多场高层会：联大、海合会与习特会被能源危机绑上同一周
items.summary_zh: 阿拉比亚英文网9月20日评论：金砖新德里峰会与休斯敦G20能源部长会刚过，阴影转入联大周——特朗普与海合会领导人、以及与习近平的会晤都被预期聚焦伊战、霍尔木兹与曼德。文章称东西向管线遇袭后，理论上延布北上经苏伊士/SUMED的绕行能力亦受胡塞射程与库存天数约束；周末投射物已逼近利雅得。

quotes.author: Al Arabiya English
quotes.en: The meeting between Trump and GCC leaders will focus on the Iran war, its impact on the global economy and damage to infrastructure in the Gulf.
quotes.zh: 特朗普与海合会领导人的会晤将聚焦伊朗战争、其对全球经济的冲击，以及海湾基础设施受损问题。

items.title: Communication by means of modulated Johnson noise
items.title_zh: 用调制约翰逊噪声通信
items.summary_zh: PNAS 论文探索以热噪声本身为载体的极低速率通信；硬核评论盯上所用 RF 开关型号，也有人追问 1.5 米、26 bps 到底能承载什么。

quotes.author: chicken-stew
quotes.en: I’m away from computer so only skimmed the article until I noticed they use the ADG90x RF switch family. IIRC that family has a single positive supply rail, and they make a nagative rail internally. The advantage is easy of implementation but you also inject some noise depending on switch position. Is this dealt with in the pub?
quotes.zh: 我现在不在电脑旁，只扫到他们用 ADG90x 这族 RF 开关。我记得那系列有些坑。

quotes.author: moezd
quotes.en: 26 bps at 1.5 m: And what exactly do we expect to carry with this communication channel? If you add horned antennas it becomes a ridiculous design just to gain a few more bytes. If you add antenna arrays then it's no longer cheap. Your transmitter's output power is basically hard limited by Boltzmann constant, so just increasing range means you will have a bad time decoding it. Digital tricks, cryogenics... maybe a few more bytes, but is it enough? I'm really struggling to see if this can be useful for anything. Dicke radiometer reference is cool, though.
quotes.zh: 1.5 米、26 bps：我们到底指望这条信道承载什么？就算再加喇叭天线，也快不到哪去。

items.title: How a Saudi pipeline attack is putting Europe’s oil security to the test

items.title: North Sea oil premiums soar to records as Saudis cut sales
items.title_zh: 沙特削减销售推高北海原油升水至纪录，长途贸易运力更紧

items.title: Every Nvidia GPU has 10 to 30 RISC-V cores inside it
items.title_zh: 每块英伟达 GPU 里都有十几到三十颗 RISC-V 核
items.summary_zh: 报道梳理消费级/数据中心 GPU 板上那些负责电源、风扇与管理任务的 RISC-V 微控制器；评论认为这才是 RISC-V 的甜点场景，也有修板视频党表示早就在探针 SPI。

quotes.author: wildzzz
quotes.en: That's really the best use for RISCV, small embedded microcontrollers handling mundane tasks. I think it's cool people are trying to turn it into a desktop and server platform but it really stands out as being a much cheaper Cortex-M or Cortex-R replacement.
quotes.zh: 这才是 RISC-V 最好的用法：小嵌入式微控制器干杂活。我觉得大家意识到这一点挺酷。

quotes.author: xyx0826
quotes.en: Neat. I’ve been watching a lot of Nvidia board level repair videos; the technician would occasionally probe the SPI signal lines to the flash chip containing “VBIOS” code to see if the GPU shows signs of life. Given no external microcontrollers on the board, I’ve always wondered what is the type of core that runs mundane tasks like executing the boot ROM, controlling PWM output for the fans, setting RGB LED colors etc. My guess was on Cortex-M, but I guess I might be wrong. I think Nvidia made a good choice to concentrate logic into the main die, despite a CPU usually having a separate EC (Embedded Controller) or Super IO chip to deal with bootstrapping and fluff. It likely helped board vendors avoid having to go through 50 STM32 copycat product lines during COVID, even though this means t
quotes.zh: 有意思。我看过很多英伟达板级维修视频；技师偶尔会去探 SPI 信号。
